explanation: The crew fired a ring of still cameras in rapid sequence around the actor, then used computers to fill in the frames between them.

claims.text: The Matrix (1999) popularized the effect known as bullet time.
A dolly zoom, stop motion and time-lapse are different techniques.
The Matrix's bullet time shots used a ring of still cameras fired in rapid sequence around the actor.
Computer interpolation filled in the frames between the still cameras' images.
